literal: Of whatever greatness it is, even if, action-excellence those-who-lack-with, not-it-is, fortress.
translation: Even if a fortress possesses every kind of greatness, it is nothing to those who lack excellence in action.
modern: ஒரு கோட்டை எவ்வளவு பெருமைகளை உடையதாக இருந்தாலும், சிறந்த செயல் திறன் இல்லாதவர்களிடம் அது பயனில்லாதது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that the physical strength of a fortress is secondary to the capability of its defenders. The phrase 'எனைமாட்சித்து' (of whatever greatness) covers all the physical attributes a fortress might have, such as height, thickness, and provisions. 'வினைமாட்சி' means excellence in action or tactical execution. The word 'இல்லது' (it is not) strongly declares that without capable defenders, the fortress effectively ceases to exist as a defense. Thus, human effort and skill are the true foundation of any defense.
